concepts.name: 떠오른 봉인
concepts.lore: 저주에 묶인 힘이 봉인 고리로 드러난다.
concepts.design: ONE thin silver circular open hoop with exactly two small navy clasps at left/right, floating teal HEART / amber SWORD inside completely open center. This concept alone is the selected slim ring continuity option. No backplate. Acquisition: hoop rapidly shrinks into a small ring pulse near sneaker, icon dissolves.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE polished 1536x1024 landscape concept sheet for a realistically buildable bonus pickup in Tralalero Shooter.
USER REQUIREMENTS: each sheet is one DISTINCT concept, NOT another ring variation. EXACT SAME bonus mesh, material, icon, scale and behavior works unchanged in HARBOR, HIGHWAY, REST STOP. Never adapt item to each location. No food, offering plates, table, pedestal, shrine, roadside altar, scene-specific stand. It is a standalone low floating power pickup.
REFERENCE 1: previously liked slim ring sheet ONLY for craft quality, satin pearl/silver, navy accents, jewel teal health and amber attack, familiar gray shark and cyan-white sneakers. Do NOT copy the ring silhouette except if specific design asks a hoop. Reference 2: actual HIGHWAY stage, Korean dark asphalt road, white lanes, green gantry sign, green/magenta route paint, guardrails, city. Reference 3: actual REST STOP stage, central asphalt route, small Korean rest-area shops, parking sides, gray tile roof, trees. These are background anchors, avoid copying giant signs or illegible HUD.
LAYOUT consistent across series: warm cream sheet and thin navy rounded panel edges, short top header EXACT TITLE below plus small "공통 보너스 시안". UPPER 60% split: left 60% a large studio display labelled "형태" showing BOTH health and attack versions of the exact proposed object, substantial readable silhouettes and visible construction; right 40% close-up labelled "획득" showing amber item doing its SPECIFIC acquisition action toward ONE existing cyan-white sneaker still worn by gray shark foot. Keep effect small and clean, use implied shrink/movement, no arrows. LOWER 33%: THREE equal game-view panels labelled "항구", "고속도로", "휴게소", all show the EXACT SAME PAIR of teal-health and amber-attack pickups low above traversable ground, with clear space between. Ground/environments differ but OBJECTS MUST BE IDENTICAL in all 3 panels. Harbor is sunny wooden seafood market boardwalk, striped blue-white stalls and sea. Highway/Rest Stop follow references. Small familiar gray shark at bottom of gameplay views, camera elevated from rear, character secondary. Do not invent extra legs or change character equipment.
TEXT compact under both studio models: "체력 +13" and "공격력 +14%". Use same compact stat labels in game panels only if space permits, never huge HUD. No English paragraphs, construction callouts, product slogans, lore essays or additional invented text.
CRAFT: clean confidently beveled geometry, controlled roughness and broad reflections, thin outlines, polished stylized actual-game look. Straightforward Unity/Blender rigid mesh primitives or outlined silhouette extrusions, 1-5 simple mesh parts and relief/flat icon. No intricate microdetail, fluid/cloth simulation, skeletal rig, expensive transparency, volumetric effects or photoreal cinematic materials. Default overall width about one sneaker length to 1.5 sneaker lengths, never a giant gate.
VFX: at most one or two short thin light streaks, a handful of glints; no stars, smoke, poison cloud, flames, electrical web, tall beam, environment destruction or glow obscuring the shoe. Do not turn all acquisition panels into a static glowing ring; obey specific animation idea.
Do not depict unapproved new mechanics such as random reward selection, added weapons, summons or permanent shoe replacement. These are alternate representations of the SAME existing health/attack bonus. Same chosen shape must be used in every panel.

concepts.name: 신발끈 개조 버클
concepts.lore: 저주 신발에 흡수되어 잠시 성능을 높이는 개조 부품.
concepts.design: A small WIDE HORIZONTAL shoelace clasp: navy beveled lozenge metal bar, pearl-white rounded end caps, two short thick folded lace loops visible behind, large embossed teal heart / amber sword on face. concepts.name: 응축된 힘의 결정
